summary.zh-CN: 三位员工覆盖外联研究、会前简报与通话跟进：外联研究员工（团队负责人）对指定账户清单评分并给出待审外联，会前简报员工为下一次会议写 INTERNAL 简报，通话跟进员工在拿到笔记后起草未发送回顾。不发送、不加入序列、不预约。
summary.en: Three employees research accounts, prepare meetings and draft call follow-ups. The outbound researcher leads; outreach, recaps and proposed meeting times remain for your review.

now.zh-CN: 添加后创建原团队的 3 位员工（负责人：外联研究员工），每位员工绑定原技能方法与完整原 PROFILE 工作方法与资料；原技能的六段方法正文未改。
now.en: Adds the original team's 3 employees (lead: Outbound), each bound to its original skills and complete PROFILE working method and reference; the six-field skill bodies are unchanged.

now.zh-CN: 团队定义、交接与启动指令以原文保留为资料参考；例行任务以未排程的工作模板提供，由你测试后再建计划。
now.en: Team definition, handoffs and kickoff are kept verbatim as references; routines ship as unscheduled work templates for you to test and then schedule.

needs.zh-CN: 你已配置可用模型；员工在 L1 草稿自治级别工作，只产出待审成果。
needs.en: A working model configured by you; employees work at autonomy L1 and only produce review-ready artifacts.

needs.zh-CN: 需要 GitHub 或 Notion 只读数据时，由你在连接页配置对应连接器；原模板还用到 Gmail, Google Calendar, LinkedIn, Slack，本包未提供对应工具；可先提供材料，或另外配置应用并授权。
needs.en: Configure the GitHub or Notion connector yourself when read-only data is needed; the originals also use Gmail, Google Calendar, LinkedIn, Slack, whose tools are not declared here; provide material or configure and authorize suitable apps separately.

permissions.zh-CN: 不发送、不发布、不合并、不付款、不改生产、不建工单、不加入序列；连接只声明只读工具。
permissions.en: Never sends, publishes, merges, pays, changes production, files issues or enrolls anyone; connections declare read-only tools only.

permissions.zh-CN: 不携带作者账号、密钥、记忆或会话；例行任务不自动启用。
permissions.en: Carries no author accounts, secrets, memory or conversations; routines are not enabled automatically.

modifications.zh-CN: 来源：cobusgreyling/grok-bot-templates@4f3f28b4e657 teams/sales（MIT，Cobus Greyling）。原 template.yaml / PROFILE.md 映射为 teloa.role/v1，原件逐字节保留在 references/。
modifications.en: Source: cobusgreyling/grok-bot-templates@4f3f28b4e657 teams/sales (MIT, Cobus Greyling). template.yaml / PROFILE.md mapped to teloa.role/v1; originals kept byte for byte under references/.

modifications.zh-CN: 原 SKILL.md 加 Teloa frontmatter 与修改声明，删去 Grok 的粘贴/斜杠命令说明；六段方法正文不变，skill.yaml 原样保留。
modifications.en: Original SKILL.md gets Teloa frontmatter and a change notice; Grok paste/slash-command lines removed; the six-field method is unchanged and skill.yaml is kept verbatim.

modifications.zh-CN: 协调者以 role-coordination 关联显式映射到成员；启动指令与交接保留原文参考，不自动运行或授予权限；例行任务转为未排程工作模板；只声明 GitHub/Notion 只读连接。
modifications.en: The coordinator is explicitly linked to each member by role-coordination. Kickoff and handoffs remain original references and do not automatically run work or grant authority. Routines become unscheduled work templates; only GitHub/Notion read-only connections are declared.

modifications.zh-CN: 团队清单与目录共用 Teloa 人类可读标题，来源保留在说明中；方法使用本团队版本名称，仅名称和对应引用变化，执行正文、原始参考、许可与既有版本保留。
modifications.zh-TW: 團隊清單與目錄共用 Teloa 易讀標題，來源保留在說明中；方法使用本團隊版本名稱，僅名稱及對應引用變更，執行正文、原始參考、授權及既有版本保留。
modifications.en: The team manifest and catalog share human-readable Teloa titles; attribution stays in the description. Family/version method names change only native identities and their references; execution bodies, raw references, licenses and existing versions are retained.

conditions.zh-CN: 添加时一次确认安装包内全部原技能；员工、资料、工作模板与可选连接按 Teloa 方案接收流程逐项启用，不自动运行。
conditions.en: Adding installs all bundled original skills in one confirmation; employees, references, work templates and optional connections are enabled through Teloa's solution flow and never run on their own.

conditions.zh-CN: 原模板为 Grok Bot 共享云电脑写就（浏览器、/workspace 文件、连接器）；在 Teloa 中浏览与文件能力取决于你授予员工的工具，未授予时员工只按你提供的材料工作。
conditions.en: The originals were written for Grok Bot's shared cloud computer (browser, /workspace files, connectors); in Teloa browsing and file access depend on the tools you grant, otherwise employees work from the material you provide.

conditions.zh-CN: 未在 Teloa 宿主中用真实模型端到端验证本团队；原仓库的示例输出是虚构样例。
conditions.en: Not verified end to end with a real model in a Teloa host; the repository's example outputs are fictional samples.
